_readme: S602 SkySombrero, 2026-11-07. Los Medanos College's local A.A. and A.S. records fail arithmetic because the program pages name the 60-unit degree and 'LMC General Education' with no units (page read 42376216539: Accounting A.S. 01528, Fine Arts A.A. 01546). A reconcile step for them must cite LMC's own words, and the Cal-GETC step's source (S600) cites Monterey Peninsula's GE page, which belongs to another college. This read finds LMC's own general education and graduation pages from the catalog's front page and prints what they say. No URL for them is on file, so the front page's matching links are shown and up to five are followed. No model call. The degrees hub (26-27/degrees, S401) is read the same way, and two guessed content-call slugs (S402's form) try the GE page directly; a miss costs one load each.

questions.local_ge_units: How many units LMC's local general education pattern (for the A.A. and A.S.) requires, in the page's own words.
questions.electives: Whether the page says electives or degree-applicable units make up the rest of the 60, and in what words.
questions.cal_getc_units: Whether an LMC page states the units Cal-GETC carries (34) for the AA-T and AS-T, so the transfer step can cite LMC instead of another college.
